title: Investigating Prosocial Behavior Theory in LLM Agents under Policy-Induced Inequities

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating policy-induced structural inequities by applying "burden asymmetry" (assigning unequal costs or effort for prosocial tasks based on an agent's income level, such as rich vs. poor) and "reward asymmetry", then measuring the resulting impact on the LLM agents' prosocial intentions and third-party punishment behaviors.
